The general proposed sufficient repair follows from injectivity and K K-dagger K=K (giving K-dagger K=I), then ||I-K-dagger A||<=||K-dagger|| ||K-A||<1 and Neumann inversion; Bessel synthesis supplies the frame bound. Equality product=1 fails in this example; no necessity claim.
